annotations.text:
M0 — artboards on mock data. The numbers come from docs/m0-design-brief.md and agree across artboards, but none of them is a truth about the chain: there are no real slots here.
There will be no Jito BAM integration in the product — this is a test bench that replays a recorded block.
The centrepiece: 547 ribbons between two texture columns. 635 of 1,182 transactions did not move and draw nothing — that emptiness is information.

T060, 2026-09-25. The landing, in the register of a report of measurement: the page's one honest claim is a measurement, and a report is the only frame in which a FAILED row is content rather than an apology.
Three faces where the app has one - serif headings, sans prose, monospace figures. The app is an instrument; this is a document about the instrument.
Red appears exactly twice on the page, both about SC-003. The proof plate deliberately carries no red marks: the detector reports no sandwich on slot 445553238, so a screenshot showing one would be a fabrication.
Figures verified on 2026-09-25 by running apply + runMetrics over the shipped fixture, not copied from the docs.
